# cpanel_api_token (Data Source)

Looks up cPanel API token metadata by name without exposing its secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_api_token" "automation" {
  name = "terraform-automation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The API token name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The token creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `expires_at` (Number) The Unix timestamp when the token expires, or `0` for no expiration.
- `features` (Set of String) The feature names attached to a limited token.
- `has_full_access` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports that the token has full account access.
- `whitelist_ips` (Set of String) The source IP restrictions reported by cPanel.
